question: What is another common name for an operating room?
explanation: An operating room is frequently referred to as an operating theatre in clinical settings. [learn more](GNS123_U5_T2#GNS123_U5_T2_h1)

question: Why is strict air pressure control maintained inside surgical suites?

options.A: To reduce the noise level of monitoring equipment
options.B: To keep the surgical team cool under heavy gowns
options.C: To dry surgical instruments quickly during procedures
options.D: To prevent airborne pathogens from entering the room

explanation: Controlled air pressure helps keep contaminants out of the sterile surgical environment. [learn more](GNS123_U5_T2#GNS123_U5_T2_h1)

question: Which procedure is typically performed in a general operating theatre?
explanation: General operating theatres handle routine procedures like hernia repairs, while complex surgeries require specialized rooms. [learn more](GNS123_U5_T2#GNS123_U5_T2_h2)

question: What distinguishes a specialized operating theatre from a general one?

options.A: Location outside the main surgical department
options.C: Presence of discipline-specific equipment and technology
options.D: Absence of scrub sinks and changing facilities

explanation: Specialized theatres house unique machinery tailored to specific branches of surgery like neurosurgery or orthopaedics. [learn more](GNS123_U5_T2#GNS123_U5_T2_h2)

question: What material is commonly used for walls in modular theatres to prevent bacterial growth?
explanation: Modular theatres use non-porous anti-bacterial panels to maintain strict hygiene standards. [learn more](GNS123_U5_T2#GNS123_U5_T2_h3)

question: What is a major advantage of using modular construction for operating rooms?

options.A: Elimination of the need for air conditioning
options.B: Permission to bypass standard hand scrubbing
options.D: Lower requirement for sterile surgical gowns

explanation: Prefabricated modular components allow hospitals to set up and service surgical suites much faster than traditional builds. [learn more](GNS123_U5_T2#GNS123_U5_T2_h3)

question: Where is a casualty theatre usually located within a hospital?
explanation: Proximity to the emergency department ensures rapid access for patients needing immediate surgical stabilization. [learn more](GNS123_U5_T2#GNS123_U5_T2_h4)

question: A patient with severe multiple lacerations from a road crash is brought into the hospital. Which operating environment is best suited for immediate wound debridement?
explanation: Casualty theatres are specifically designed for urgent initial wound care and trauma stabilization straight from the emergency unit. [learn more](GNS123_U5_T2#GNS123_U5_T2_h4)

question: What equipment is kept permanently ready in an emergency trauma suite?
explanation: Trauma suites must have rapid-infusion gear ready to manage massive blood loss during critical resuscitations. [learn more](GNS123_U5_T2#GNS123_U5_T2_h5)

question: Why must trauma operating suites operate on a 24-hour readiness schedule?

options.A: Sterilization equipment takes a full day to cool down
options.B: Government regulations forbid closing trauma units during daytime
options.C: Accidents and severe internal injuries occur unpredictably at any hour
options.D: Staff members prefer working night shifts in emergency settings

explanation: Because life-threatening trauma happens without warning, these suites must remain prepared for immediate activation day and night. [learn more](GNS123_U5_T2#GNS123_U5_T2_h5)

question: Which zone of the operating department permits staff to wear regular street clothes?
explanation: The unrestricted zone serves as the entrance area where street clothes are still permitted before changing. [learn more](GNS123_U5_T2#GNS123_U5_T2_h6)

question: What clothing is mandatory when entering the restricted zone of an operating suite?

options.A: Disposable plastic aprons over personal wear
options.B: Standard street clothes with clean white shoes
options.C: Lab coats worn over regular everyday clothing
options.D: Surgical scrubs, caps, masks, and appropriate footwear

explanation: The restricted zone contains the sterile operating theatre, demanding full scrub attire including masks and caps. [learn more](GNS123_U5_T2#GNS123_U5_T2_h6)
